manageWordScramble.title: Word Scramble vocabulary
manageWordScramble.subtitle: Add, edit, or delete words in MongoDB. The game prefers server data; falls back to bundled TSV if empty.
manageWordScramble.subtitleUpload: Files: .txt / .tsv / .md must be TSV — first line header: word, meaning, example, difficulty, topic (columns tab-separated; example/difficulty/topic optional). .json: array of { "word", "meaning", "example?", "difficulty?", "topic?" } or { "words": [ … ] }. Game uses server data first; falls back to bundled TSV if empty.
manageWordScramble.uploadDropHint: Same TSV rules as before: header row word, meaning, example, difficulty, topic (tab-separated). JSON: array of objects or { "words": [...] }.
manageWordScramble.uploadInvalidJson: Invalid JSON: use an array of { word, meaning, … } or { "words": [ … ] }.
